V-M-EVOLVE-TYPES.Scenario: success: The type surface compiles under strict mode.

V-M-EVOLVE-SPEC.Scenario: failure: validateSpec collects multiple errors for a spec missing version / topic / goal / metrics / candidates.
failure: validateSpec rejects duplicate metric ids.
failure: validateSpec rejects candidates with more than one or zero sources.
success: validateSpec accepts a valid minimal spec.
failure: loadSpec reports spec.missing for a non-existent file.
failure: loadSpec reports spec.parse-error for broken JSON.
success: loadSpec returns ok for a valid JSON file on disk.

V-M-EVOLVE-METRIC.Scenario: success: The default parser picks the last numeric-only line.
failure: The default parser returns null plus error when no numeric line is present.
success: A custom parser regex extracts the capture group.
failure: A custom parser returns null plus error when the regex does not match.
failure: An invalid parser regex returns a descriptive error.

V-M-EVOLVE-SCORE.Scenario: success: normalizeMetric maps higher-is-better values correctly.
success: normalizeMetric returns 1 when cohort min equals max.
success: hasVeto returns false when no veto is set.
failure: hasVeto catches a value below a higher-is-better veto.
success: scoreTrials returns a per-candidate weighted score.
failure: scoreTrials returns null for trials with any null metric value.

V-M-EVOLVE-RUNNER.Scenario: success: runCandidate returns verdict=advance when all metric commands succeed and parse.
failure: runCandidate returns verdict=failed when any metric command exits non-zero.
failure: runCandidate returns verdict=failed with a "setup failed" reason when setup exits non-zero.
failure: runCandidate returns verdict=failed when the worktree path does not exist.
success: runCandidate runs teardown after metrics in order (journal-based check).

V-M-EVOLVE-WORKTREE.Scenario: success: prepareWorktree creates an isolated tree for a baseline candidate at HEAD.
success: prepareWorktree creates a temp branch and applies a patch for patch candidates.
success: cleanupWorktree removes the worktree and the temp branch.

V-M-EVOLVE-ARCHIVE.Scenario: success: archivePath sanitizes unsafe characters in the topic.
success: renderArchive emits envelope, goal, metrics, and trials.
success: renderArchive omits the optional top-level Winner / StoppedBy / FinishedAt when absent.
success: renderArchive XML-escapes special characters in topic, goal, and reason.
success: writeArchive creates the target directory and atomically writes the file.

V-M-EVOLVE-ORCHESTRATOR.Scenario: success: runEvolve walks all candidates when none of the stopping criteria trigger.
success: The winner is the trial with the highest non-null score; null when every trial failed or was vetoed.
